run.question: Which recurring contexts do symbol words share across 101 public-domain books, once book, tradition and the symbol word itself are accounted for?

sample.strategy: at most 15 per book and symbol, lowest occurrence ids, reprints (duplicate_of) left out

limitations: Groups are computed context groups of symbol-word occurrences, not universal symbol meanings.

Group names are generated terms, unreviewed.
Fitted on the evaluation half of the books only; the published map uses all books with seed 42.
English translations dominate; translator wording is part of what a book contributes.
